transcription: I dislike that Father's Day is ruined for me, this is going to be a long one. I can't bring myself to tell any of this to anyone in my life but I need someone to know. Growing up by 39 meters never knew my dad 53 meters. I just knew I had the same dad as my oldest brother 10 years older than me and they had a relationship with each other. And my other brother 4 years older had a different dad and they also had a relationship. I just had my mom F65 who was crazy and damaged. When I was young I didn't realize how messed up this situation was. I just knew that one day when I have kids they would know that they were loved and wanted. It is a core part of me to this day. It really gives my life meaning and Father's Day really meant a lot to me. When I was 19 I had a girlfriend who got pregnant and I was excited to become a father. I wasn't in love with this person 24F however. She pursued me and got pregnant within a couple of weeks. When I found out I took responsibility and did everything I thought I was meant to. Asked her to marry me, took her to doc appointment, was faithful. I was going to do right by this child. Right around 8 months later she disappears with her mom F64 and I don't hear from her for like 6 months when she called asking for me to pay child support. Which I did for a year or so and got to see the little girl 3 times. It broke my heart. Then this be says that the baby isn't mine and she was cheating on me the whole time. Sent me a fake paternity test and everything. I did everything I thought was right for that child because I didn't want her to grow up like me. This only made my resolve to be a good dad stronger. That note turns out she was mine. And that ex was just crazy as crap. Found out when my daughter was 9 years old. Mother had got into drugs and lost custody of her. I tracked her down through DHS and she had been happily adopted to a very loving family who are very well off. I gave them my contact info for when or if she is ready. A couple years later I met my wife married 15 years. I was in love truly and fully. A year after that she 35F got pregnant and I knew I was finally going to have the family I always dreamed of. Four months into the pregnancy she got a job overnight at Walmart. We didn't get to see each other as much. But I went to every doc's appointment, rubbed her feet, belly with lotion every day. I was all in. Then she started acting weird and distant but I thought it was just the baby hormones. And on the first father's day, while she was still pregnant, we both had the day off and she refused sex and was mean as crud to me then had a friend come pick her up and left me alone the whole day. Which broke my heart because she knew how much the day meant. But I eventually forgave her and moved on. Well, four years later and pregnant with my second child she admits to cheating on me while pregnant for four or five months with some pause from work that was 10 year older than her. And on father's day. Pretty messed up. So now every father's day I have to pretend for my kids that I'm having a great day. But I'm so hollow inside and I cry every time they're not around. I know it's not their fault. They're perfect and sweet and kind. But I dislike father's day so much because it reminds me that no one has ever chose
